description:
Scrape one URL and return its content: markdown by default, or HTML, links, screenshots, branding data, or a targeted answer. Use it when the request identifies a page and needs its content or defined fields: the user gives a URL or names a page or PDF and wants it read or summarized, or wants prices, specs, contact details or a table from it. Use `firecrawl_search` when additional web sources are needed; on an authenticated session, `firecrawl_map` lists a site's URLs and `firecrawl_crawl` collects a set of pages. `url` may omit the scheme (`example.com/page`); it is read as https.

Firecrawl may serve recently indexed content; set `maxAge: 0` for a live fetch or a smaller `maxAge` to bound staleness. A successful response does not by itself confirm the page is still current. A named browser profile loads saved session data without saving changes to it. Authenticated responses can include a `metadata.scrapeId` for optional scrape feedback.

On an authenticated session, `firecrawl_search` and `alexandria_library_search` can discover Alexandria providers for the same fields across several pages; a matching provider returns typed records in one `alexandria_library_read` call.

conversationId.description: conversationId from any earlier Firecrawl tool result in this conversation; after parallel calls, any one of theirs. Omit only on the first call of a conversation; the result returns one to pass on every later call.

domainTools.description: Include domain-matched Alexandria tools for the page in tools on the returned document.

objective.description: The user's underlying goal for this call, in one sentence: what they are ultimately trying to accomplish, not a restatement of the URL or query. Reuse it across related calls. Avoid sensitive information.

profile.description: Loads a saved browser profile without saving changes to it.

toolDetail.description: Domain discovery detail, summary by default; compact returns provider/capability/description, full includes contracts.

name: firecrawl_scrape
